title: 巴菲特：只做「重要且可知」的事
description:
巴菲特语录第三十八条：我不研究宏观问题。

投资里最紧要的，是先分清一件事到底「重要不重要」「可知不可知」。既不重要、又不可知的，直接别管——这就是能力圈的边界。

他说过一句更狠的：就算格林斯潘悄悄告诉我未来两年的货币政策，我也不会改变任何一个行为。道理很简单：他买的是能穿越周期的生意，日常生活离不开、护城河足够深的龙头品牌。一旦持有就远远跨过宏观周期，短期政策变化和市场波动影响不大。

有所不为，才能有所为。把注意力放回你真正能掌握的地方：所投企业和竞争对手的经营状况，以及这个行业的未来趋势。

#巴菲特 #价值投资 #能力圈 #护城河 #投资心法 #长期持有

quotes.zh: 投资中最紧要的是弄清什么事是重要的、可知的。
quotes.en: What matters most in investing is working out what is important and knowable.

quotes.zh: 即使格林斯潘悄悄告诉我未来两年的货币政策，我也不会改变我的任何一个行为。
quotes.en: Even if Greenspan quietly told me the next two years of monetary policy, I would not change a single one of my actions.
Only by refusing to do some things can you get anything done.

translations: Buffett, quote 38: I don't study macroeconomic questions.
What matters most in investing is working out what is important and knowable.
If something is unimportant and unknowable, just leave it alone.
Dr. Zeng's commentary. Buffett once said: even if Greenspan quietly told me the next two years of monetary policy,
I would not change a single one of my actions.
Because what Buffett buys are businesses that ride through cycles — indispensable to everyday life, with deep moats, leading brands — and once he owns them,
he holds far beyond the macro cycle, so short-term policy shifts and market swings matter little.
Only by refusing to do some things can you get anything done.
Investing means focusing on what truly matters and what you can actually grasp: how your companies and their rivals are really operating,
the future direction of the industry they are in, and so on.
